findings.sentence: Pay Health Cost and Empower costs in Stoneskin first.
findings.actual: Only the Health component is substituted. The Time component is added to the turn bill, and an Exhaust cost also remains an Exhaust.
findings.scenario: At (2,4) with 6 Stoneskin, Empower Overhead Smash against the adjacent crawler at (3,4). The relic promises Stoneskin first for the Empower cost. The card pays base 6 plus 2 Time and keeps all 6 Stoneskin.
findings.name: Iron Lung

findings.sentence: Deal half the Stoneskin gained to each adjacent enemy, rounded down, up to 4.
findings.actual: The damage hook runs when the hero gains Stoneskin from a card or reward as well as on the turn-end conversion named in the preceding sentence.
findings.scenario: With 0 Block at (2,4) and an enemy at (3,4), play Raise the Anvil on (2,3). The card grants 6 Stoneskin. The adjacent enemy immediately loses 3 Health without ending the turn or converting any Block.
findings.name: Worldheart

findings.actual: Light 2 is recalculated from live illusions. A destroyed illusion leaves no source behind. The Light definition says Light reveals for the rest of combat.
findings.scenario: In Eclipse, Blink with Dust Skip from (2,4) to (2,3). The 2-Health decoy at (2,4) emits Light 2 and reveals (2,6). The crawler on (3,4) destroys the closer decoy with Skitter Strike. The Light disappears and (2,6) becomes hidden while combat continues.
findings.name: Eclipse Mantle

findings.sentence: Blink creates Light at both ends.
findings.actual: Both endpoint sources pass through the same attack-card filter as the Move trail. A Blink on a card with an excluded action creates neither source.
findings.scenario: Play Spur Vault from (2,4), Blink to (3,4), then Push the crawler on (4,4). The card completes the Blink and attack. Neither endpoint gains the promised Light.
findings.name: Pilgrim Boots

findings.sentence: While you have Stoneskin, cards that give Block give 3 more.
findings.actual: The modifier applies to an action of type Block. The per-tile Block rider on Move grants Block directly.
findings.scenario: With 6 Stoneskin and 0 Block, play Catch the Wind from (2,4) to (2,2). Two tiles grant 2 Block. The relic promises 3 more, but the hero ends the card with 2 Block.
findings.name: Reinforced Shield

findings.sentence: When an Ice card Staggers an enemy on Ice, leave Rubble on that enemy's tile and each adjacent tile.
findings.actual: The printed cross depicts five tiles. The rule unions a cross at every occupied footprint tile, even when a single tile of that footprint is on Ice.
findings.scenario: Tharokh occupies a 2×2 footprint anchored at (4,3), with Ice at the anchor and no walls around the footprint. Play White Silence. Twelve tiles get Rubble, including (6,3), outside the depicted five-tile cross.
findings.name: Shatterglass Prism

findings.sentence: When Fire, Ice or Electrified replaces another of those grounds, place the new ground on each adjacent tile without Fire, Ice or Electrified.
findings.actual: The spread checks player provenance. Enemy ground replacement does not spread.
findings.scenario: Stand on Ice at (2,4) while Arc Thrall at (3,4) uses Arc Bolt during its activation. All four adjacent tiles lack elemental ground. Arc Bolt replaces the Ice with Electrified. Only the hero tile becomes Electrified.
findings.name: Overflow Censer

findings.sentence: Attacks on cards that cost 6 or more Time gain Pierce.
findings.actual: The threshold uses base Time before discounts and surcharges. The relic still supplies Pierce below the threshold after a discount and misses a card raised above the threshold by a surcharge.
findings.scenario: With Whirling Sash, play Brace and Polar Guard at (2,4), then shoot the crawler at (5,4) with Dull Bolt. The card shows and pays 6 Time and receives no Pierce. In a separate turn, Static Rush reduces Overhead Smash to 4 Time and the attack retains Pierce.
findings.name: Hourglass Awl

findings.sentence: Moving across Ice without turning costs only 1 Movement.
findings.actual: The first step pays normal departure cost. A straight continuation subtracts one from normal cost. Rubble can coexist with Ice and increases the cost of leaving the tile.
findings.scenario: Place Ice on (2,4) and (3,4), with Rubble under the Ice at (2,4). Start on (2,4) with 2 Movement and Move straight to (3,4). The single step spends both Movement.
findings.name: Winter's Spur

findings.sentence: Once per turn, your single-target hit on a tile without Fire, Ice or Electrified places Fire.
findings.actual: Only an enemy hit can reach the Fire hook. This excludes a terrain hit even if the hit destroys the terrain and leaves a legal Fire tile.
findings.scenario: Play Raise the Anvil to make an Outcrop on bare floor at (3,4). Then destroy it with Overhead Smash from (2,4) before using the relic's Fire trigger. The Outcrop is gone and the struck tile remains without Fire.
findings.name: Crowncoal Heart

findings.sentence: Attacks on cards that cost 5 or more Time gain +1 Stagger.
findings.actual: The threshold uses base Time before discounts and surcharges. The relic still supplies +1 Stagger below the threshold after a discount and misses a card raised above the threshold by a surcharge.
findings.scenario: With Whirling Sash, play Brace and Polar Guard at (2,4), then shoot the crawler at (5,4) with Dull Bolt. The card shows and pays 6 Time and receives no +1 Stagger. In a separate turn, Static Rush reduces Overhead Smash to 4 Time and the attack retains +1 Stagger.
findings.name: Leaden Pommel

findings.sentence: While you stand on Ice, your Ice cards deal +2 damage.
findings.actual: The modifier accepts only the listed attack action types. White Silence uses a separate selector-hit action.
findings.scenario: Stand on Ice at (2,4), with a crawler with no Expose on Ice at (3,4). Play White Silence. The target loses the printed 6 Health where the relic promises 8.
findings.name: Hobnail Cleats

findings.sentence: At the start of combat, create an Illusion with Health 2 on the empty tile adjacent to you nearest an enemy.
findings.actual: The sort considers only visible enemies. If none are visible, it chooses the legal adjacent tile nearest the center of the board.
findings.scenario: Start Eclipse combat at (2,4), with all adjacent tiles open and the only enemy hidden at (2,1). The nearest tile is (2,3). The illusion appears on the center-facing tile (3,4). No card is played.
findings.name: Waxen Effigy

findings.sentence: When a card gives you Block, also gain Retaliate 1, once per card.
findings.actual: The normal Block action and certain card rewards call the Retaliate hook. Per-tile Block on a Move does not call it.
findings.scenario: Play Catch the Wind from (2,4) to (2,2) with no Block or Retaliate. The card grants 2 Block and no Retaliate.
findings.name: Briar Vambrace

findings.sentence: For your Lightning cards, your Outcrops and Illusions count as Electrified and take no damage from those cards.
findings.actual: The virtual-conductor board is used by the attack planner. Discharge instead enumerates actual Electrified ground, so a construct on bare floor cannot extend its network.
findings.scenario: Play Discharge at the only Electrified tile (4,4), with your illusion at (5,4) and a crawler at (5,3). If the illusion tile counted as Electrified for that card, its Burst would reach the crawler. The crawler loses 0 Health.
findings.name: Copper-Shod Staff

findings.sentence: For your Lightning cards, your Outcrops and Illusions count as Electrified and take no damage from those cards.
findings.actual: Ordinary Lightning attack terrain protection does not carry over to the Burst. Discharge damages owned illusions in the affected area.
findings.scenario: In the same Discharge setup, the real Electrified tile at (4,4) Bursts into the owned 2-Health illusion at (5,4). The illusion is destroyed despite the promised damage immunity.
findings.name: Copper-Shod Staff

findings.sentence: Your Push and Pull can move your Illusions safely.
findings.actual: The aimed attack component is skipped, but wall collision uses the ordinary force damage path. Only a moved illusion hitting an enemy uses the special shatter rule.
findings.scenario: Play Shield Charge from (2,4), Move to (3,4), and Push your 2-Health illusion at (4,4) two tiles east. It moves to (5,4) and is destroyed by the wall at (6,4).
findings.name: Hollow Puppet

findings.sentence: Your attacks deal +3 damage to each enemy set to act after your next turn on the Turn Clock.
findings.actual: The bonus compares against the hypothetical normal-cost next turn, even while an unused Borrowed Hourglass schedules an immediate next turn ahead of the enemy.
findings.scenario: With Borrowed Hourglass unspent, start at clock 0 and Quick Stab the adjacent crawler scheduled at 5. Leave one Card Play unused. Your next turn is at 0, before the crawler. Quick Stab deals 6 instead of 9.
findings.name: Toll of the Late Bell

findings.sentence: Your Retaliate no longer expires and grows by 1 whenever your Retaliate deals damage.
findings.actual: The growth hook runs on any active Retaliate reaction, including a rider-only reaction whose damage starts and ends at zero.
findings.scenario: Play Static Mantle without any prior Retaliate. The adjacent crawler uses Skitter Strike. The Mantle's Shock rider triggers without dealing damage. Retaliate damage still grows from 0 to 1.
findings.name: Briar Throne

borderline.reason: Inline Push or Pull, such as Slipstream Cut's rider, gains distance while the damage belongs to the separate Melee attack. Reading the sentence as naming the two native action types makes this consistent. The same distinction applies to Anchor Chain.
borderline.name: Tailwind Fletching

borderline.reason: At 9 Block the hero gets two layers and loses all 9 Block. The rate might suggest keeping a leftover point, while ‘trade your Block’ explicitly describes the entire pool.
borderline.name: Cold Mirror

borderline.reason: Survival alone does not override immunity or footprint landing legality. ‘Can swap’ describes an optional technique and normal Swap restrictions still apply.
borderline.name: Thunder Relay

borderline.reason: Dead and reflected targets do not take rebound damage. A dead enemy cannot be hit again. Reflect already explains why the outgoing shot did not land.
borderline.name: Storm Crown

borderline.reason: The option exists on native ground-fuel Burst actions. Destroying an Illusion, Outcrop or an Electrified network uses separate Burst action types. ‘Instead of Fire’ signals that the text describes the ground-fuel option.
borderline.name: Basalt Kiln

borderline.reason: The global conductor override can also let an enemy Lightning attack conduct through Fire and remove it. The relic text guarantees the player-card interaction and leaves enemy conduction unspecified.
borderline.name: Stormcoal Crucible

borderline.reason: The next attack on the card that grants the buff cannot use it. Code makes the next qualifying attack a later card's attack. Native Expend cards commonly put their removal on or after the hit, so the missing timing detail alone is insufficient.
borderline.name: Black Sun Dial

borderline.reason: Quick Stab followed by an elemental card does not qualify. Neutral cards use no element, so ‘whose element differs’ can reasonably require two actual elements.
borderline.name: Chorus Mask

borderline.reason: Stagger is tracked as an initiative delay. The spread counts Expose, Shock and Immobilize. The glossary describes Stagger as an action, so Stagger plus one persistent status does not decisively contradict ‘different statuses.’
borderline.name: Funeral Bell

borderline.reason: At four elements an existing Chain 2 remains Chain 2. ‘Add Chain 1’ names the keyword and can read as supplying at least Chain 1. Explicit ‘+1 Chain’ elsewhere means a numeric increment.
borderline.name: Fivefold Knot

borderline.reason: It recognizes placed, owned sources rather than tethered light, and only paid steps refund. The same placed-source boundary applies to Unclouded Sun. Ownership of a borrowed or tethered source and refunding a free step are both ambiguous.
borderline.name: Beaconrunner Spurs

borderline.reason: The second sentence could be read across separate Burst actions. Runtime counts overlapping Fire crosses within one Fire-ground Burst, and uses maximum overlap on a large enemy's occupied tiles. Typical single-tile overlaps agree with the copy.
borderline.name: Ashen Brand

borderline.reason: With Skate active an Ice step can be free. The explicit wording ‘only 1’ admits the better cost under a separate overriding effect. The expensive Rubble overlap is documented as a finding.
borderline.name: Winter's Spur

borderline.reason: The planned hop index can include a Reflect contact. Whether Chain already ‘hit’ a unit whose shot reflected depends on whether hit names the contact or the damage landing.
borderline.name: Resonant Clapper

borderline.reason: The new rate replaces base Collision damage. Independent Expose can still increase the hit, as normal.
borderline.name: Recoil Plates

borderline.reason: A Retaliate hit absorbed by Block or Stoneskin yields only the residual Health loss as Block. ‘Damages an attacker’ can mean Health lost. Counted as ambiguity because the hit still follows ordinary defenses.
borderline.name: Martyr's Gorget

borderline.reason: A stationary enemy blocker can take Collision damage without losing the ground under its own tile. ‘When an enemy collides’ can reasonably refer to the moving party.
borderline.name: The Breaking Wheel

borderline.reason: The nearest legal foe is chosen after the player card finishes. A decoy with no reachable foe pays no Health. ‘Up to 3’ and ‘nearest reachable’ cover this normal targeting limit.
borderline.name: Mirror Triptych

borderline.reason: The card goes to the draw pile if the hand is already capped. This is an ordinary capacity exception. The unit did not establish a repeatable normal turn start at the cap.
borderline.name: Pyre-Keeper's Urn

coverage.name: Iron Lung
coverage.treasure_text: Pay [icon Health Cost] Health Cost and Empower costs in [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin first. Each [icon Health] Health costs 2 Stoneskin.
coverage.actual: The conversion spends two Stoneskin per Health of base or Empower Health costs. Time and Exhaust Empower costs follow separate paths.

coverage.name: Brightglass Lens
coverage.treasure_text: Your Ranged attacks against enemies in [icon Light] Light gain +1 Chain.
coverage.actual: Adds Chain 1 to the route of a ranged attack against an enemy whose footprint intersects Light.

coverage.name: Pilgrim Boots
coverage.treasure_text: [diagram cross] Gain 1 Movement each turn. Moving without attacking leaves [icon Light] Light 1 on tiles you enter. Blink creates Light at both ends.
coverage.actual: Adds one Movement capacity and creates radius-1 Light at entered Move tiles or both Blink endpoints. The attack-card exclusion applies to both.

coverage.name: Mirror Shard
coverage.treasure_text: When one of your [icon Illusion] illusions is destroyed, deal 3 damage to each enemy adjacent to that illusion.
coverage.actual: Illusion destruction pulses for 3 against each living enemy with a tile adjacent to the illusion.

coverage.name: Coffin Nails
coverage.treasure_text: When an enemy attack hits your [icon Block] Block and deals no [icon Health] Health damage, the attacker gains [icon Expose] Expose 2.
coverage.actual: An enemy attack with positive Block loss and zero Health loss gives its attacker Expose 2.

coverage.name: Reinforced Shield
coverage.treasure_text: While you have [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin, cards that give [icon Block] Block give 3 more.
coverage.actual: At one or more Stoneskin the relic adds 3 to the Block action amount. It misses Move's inline per-tile Block.

coverage.name: Iron Buckler
coverage.treasure_text: At the start of your turn, keep up to 3 of your [icon Block] Block.
coverage.actual: At player turn reset, retain the smaller of the existing Block and the relic's cap of 3.

coverage.name: Flint Edge
coverage.treasure_text: Your Melee attacks remove the [icon Fire] Fire, [icon Ice] Ice or [icon Electrified] Electrified under the target to deal 3 more damage.
coverage.actual: Removes an elemental layer under the selected visible enemy's footprint before routing and adds 3 on the native hit.

coverage.name: Static Soles
coverage.treasure_text: Your first Move or Blink each turn leaves [icon Electrified] Electrified on the tile you left and gives you [icon Vision] Vision for 2 turns.
coverage.actual: A qualifying displacement claims the turn flag, paints origin Electrified, and applies Vision for two activations.

coverage.name: Tailwind Fletching
coverage.treasure_text: Your Air Push and Pull deal 1 more damage and move targets 1 tile farther.
coverage.actual: Air Push and Pull actions gain 1 damage and distance. Existing force riders on other actions gain the distance.

coverage.name: Shatterglass Prism
coverage.treasure_text: [diagram cross] When an Ice card [icon Stagger] Staggers an enemy on [icon Ice] Ice, leave [icon Rubble] Rubble on that enemy's tile and each adjacent tile.
coverage.actual: After successful Ice Stagger, the Rubble cross is repeated for each tile in the enemy footprint.

coverage.name: Widegap Cell
coverage.treasure_text: Your Lightning Ranged attacks with Chain gain +1 Chain.
coverage.actual: A Lightning Ranged action with base or conditional Chain has 1 added to its Chain field.

coverage.name: Gale Tabi
coverage.treasure_text: After you Blink, your next attack this turn deals +1 damage per tile, up to +4. A later Blink replaces this bonus.
coverage.actual: Each successful Blink replaces the pending bonus with its distance capped at 4. The next qualifying attack can use it in the same card.

coverage.name: Anchor Chain
coverage.treasure_text: While you have [icon Block] Block, your Push and Pull deal 2 more damage and move targets 1 tile farther.
coverage.actual: While Block is positive, native Push and Pull actions gain 2 damage and 1 distance. Inline force riders receive distance.

coverage.name: Quarry Signet
coverage.treasure_text: Enemies on [icon Rubble] Rubble take +1 damage from attacks, Collision, [icon Fire] Fire and Retaliate.
coverage.actual: Positive enemy damage on Rubble gains 1, including the four named sources.

coverage.name: Thawing Charm
coverage.treasure_text: [diagram cross:hero] Excess healing becomes [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin, up to 8 each turn. The first conversion each turn creates [icon Light] Light 1 on your tile.
coverage.actual: Converts excess Healing to Stoneskin up to a running 8 this turn. The first positive conversion creates Light 1.

coverage.name: Ember Siphon
coverage.treasure_text: [diagram neighbors:origin] When an enemy dies on [icon Fire] Fire, leave Fire on each adjacent tile without Fire, [icon Ice] Ice or [icon Electrified] Electrified.
coverage.actual: The death reaction of an enemy on Fire spreads to cardinal neighbors outside its footprint that have no elemental ground.

coverage.name: Bloodglass Knife
coverage.treasure_text: While you are at half [icon Health] Health or less with no [icon Block] Block or [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin, your attacks deal 7 more damage.
coverage.actual: Attack damage gains 7 at no more than half Health and with zero Block and Stoneskin.

coverage.name: Cold Mirror
coverage.treasure_text: When your Ice card [icon Stagger] Staggers an enemy and you have 4+ [icon Block] Block, trade your Block for 1 [icon Crystal Mantle] Crystal Mantle layer per 4 Block, up to 2.
coverage.actual: A successful Ice-card Stagger with 4 or more Block spends the whole Block pool. The payout is one Crystal Mantle layer per 4 Block, up to two.

coverage.name: Thunder Relay
coverage.treasure_text: Your Chain attacks can swap the first and last enemies hit if both survive.
coverage.actual: The optional technique exchanges the first and last living native enemy contacts if the units and landing tiles permit the swap.

coverage.name: Faultline Brooch
coverage.treasure_text: [diagram cross] Your single-target Melee attacks can spend 4 [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin to hit these tiles instead and leave [icon Rubble] Rubble on each tile.
coverage.actual: The optional mode spends 4 Stoneskin, changes melee to an area cross centered on the chosen tile, then places Rubble on the same five offsets where legal.

coverage.name: Vaulting Sigil
coverage.treasure_text: During Move, pass through enemies and Stagger each enemy you pass through by 2. End on an open tile.
coverage.actual: Move may travel through enemies and requests Stagger 2 once per traversed enemy. Occupied tiles remain unavailable as ordinary endpoints.

coverage.name: Obsidian Heart
coverage.treasure_text: At the start of combat, Draw 1 fewer card. At the end of your turn, convert your [icon Block] Block into [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin.
coverage.actual: The opening deal has a -1 draw adjustment. End of turn converts remaining Block 1:1.

coverage.name: Storm Crown
coverage.treasure_text: After the last Chain hit, hit each enemy on the route again in reverse order for half damage, rounded down.
coverage.actual: The recorded Chain route is traversed backward and surviving, unreflected contacts take half the recorded hit damage rounded down.

coverage.name: Phoenix Ember
coverage.treasure_text: Gain 1 [icon Defiance] Defiance. When Defiance saves you, create [icon Light] Light 3 on your tile, place [icon Fire] Fire under each enemy, Draw 3 and gain 3 [icon Card Play] Card Plays.
coverage.actual: Adds a Defiance charge. A Defiance recovery grants Light 3, Fire under live footprints, Draw 3 and 3 Card Plays with normal resource rules.

coverage.name: Worldroot Idol
coverage.treasure_text: On [icon Rubble] Rubble, your Melee and Ranged attacks can start from a connected Rubble tile, removing that Rubble. The game chooses the tile.
coverage.actual: While on Rubble, the engine chooses the first connected origin that can deliver a selected Melee/Ranged shot. Resolution expends that origin.

coverage.name: Rimecatcher Vial
coverage.treasure_text: When your Ice card [icon Stagger] Staggers an enemy on [icon Ice] Ice, you can move that Ice to an adjacent tile.
coverage.actual: A selected direction moves one surviving Ice tile when an Ice-card Stagger was recorded on that footprint.

coverage.name: Updraft Bottle
coverage.treasure_text: Your Push and Pull can move [icon Fire] Fire, [icon Ice] Ice or [icon Electrified] Electrified along with the target.
coverage.actual: An opted-in native Push or Pull transfers surviving elemental ground from the original footprint by the target's actual displacement.

coverage.name: Basalt Kiln
coverage.treasure_text: Your Burst can destroy [icon Rubble] Rubble instead of [icon Fire] Fire, leaving Fire on the destroyed tiles.
coverage.actual: The crush option changes a ground-fuel Burst to Rubble and paints Fire on each tile whose Rubble was actually removed.

coverage.name: Stormcoal Crucible
coverage.treasure_text: [icon Fire] Fire also conducts hits from your Lightning cards. Those hits remove the Fire on each tile the hits conduct through.
coverage.actual: Fire is a conductor with this relic and used Fire is consumed. The override is global, including enemy Lightning.

coverage.name: Captured Noon
coverage.treasure_text: While 3 or more [icon Light] Lights are active, the Umbra is 1 stage lower. With 6 or more, the Umbra is 2 stages lower.
coverage.actual: Effective Light source counts of three and six lower effective Umbra by one and two stages, bounded by Clear.

coverage.name: Overflow Censer
coverage.treasure_text: [diagram neighbors:origin] When Fire, Ice or Electrified replaces another of those grounds, place the new ground on each adjacent tile without Fire, Ice or Electrified.
coverage.actual: A player-owned elemental overwrite paints the four adjacent otherwise element-free tiles without recursion.

coverage.name: Black Sun Dial
coverage.treasure_text: Each ground tile you remove with Expend or Burst gives your next attack +3 damage, up to +9.

coverage.name: Duelist Whetstone
coverage.treasure_text: Attacks on cards that also Move or Blink deal 1 more damage per tile you moved this turn, up to 3 more.
coverage.actual: Qualifying attacks on Move or Blink cards gain one damage per tile already traveled this turn, capped at three.

coverage.name: Chorus Mask
coverage.treasure_text: A card whose element differs from the last card you played this turn deals 2 more damage and gives 2 more [icon Block] Block.
coverage.actual: Two different tracked elemental families enable the damage and Block bonus. A neutral play clears the sequence.

coverage.treasure_text: When you play a card that costs 6 or more [icon Time] Time, Quicken 2.

coverage.name: Widow Thread
coverage.treasure_text: While you have an [icon Illusion] Illusion, your attacks apply +1 [icon Expose] Expose.

coverage.name: Funeral Bell
coverage.treasure_text: When an enemy with 2 or more different statuses dies, each enemy adjacent to that enemy gains those statuses.

coverage.name: Bloodmoon Chalice
coverage.treasure_text: When you lose [icon Health] Health during your turn, your next attack this turn deals 2 more damage per Health lost, up to 8 more.

coverage.actual: A paid step into active player-owned placed Light refunds one Movement while the turn refund count is below two.

coverage.name: Witchglass Carapace
coverage.treasure_text: Enemy Ranged attacks deal at most 1 damage to your [icon Illusion] Illusions.
coverage.actual: For enemy Ranged hits, the cap of 1 is applied to illusion damage after Expose.

coverage.name: Sunlit Edge
coverage.treasure_text: While you stand in [icon Light] Light, your attacks gain Pierce.
coverage.actual: Effective Light at the hero adds Pierce to native attack types.

coverage.name: Glassway Compass
coverage.treasure_text: Your Move and Blink can end on one of your [icon Illusion] Illusions to Swap with that illusion, skipping the tiles between.
coverage.actual: Eligible Move or Blink to an owned illusion trades endpoints without traversing the route.

coverage.name: Unclouded Sun
coverage.treasure_text: When you Move, the centers of your [icon Light] Lights count as adjacent to each other.
coverage.actual: Active player-owned placed Light centers become one-step Move links.

coverage.name: Ashen Brand
coverage.treasure_text: Your Burst destroys each connected [icon Fire] Fire tile. A target hit by several Bursts takes 25% more damage per extra Burst.
coverage.actual: Fire-ground Burst expands selected seeds to connected Fire. Overlapping crosses boost one hit by 25% of base per extra overlap, using the largest tile overlap on a footprint.

coverage.name: Winter's Spur
coverage.treasure_text: Moving across [icon Ice] Ice without turning costs only 1 Movement. Turning starts a new stretch.
coverage.actual: A straight Ice-to-Ice continuation subtracts one from the normal step cost. The initial step and Rubble departure costs can make the straight stretch cost more than one.

coverage.name: Resonant Clapper
coverage.treasure_text: Your Chain deals 25% more damage per enemy it already hit. Empty relays and conduction-only hits neither count nor gain this bonus.
coverage.actual: Planned native enemy hops add 25% per prior enemy hop. Empty relays and conduction-only contacts receive no hop count.

coverage.name: Galehook Talon
coverage.treasure_text: Your Push and Pull also move each enemy lined up against the target in that direction. Only the front enemy collides.
coverage.actual: Moves a touching, axis-aligned, eligible chain of enemies together. The front blocked member receives the mover-side collision.

coverage.name: Cragbound Gauntlet
coverage.treasure_text: Your Earth cards with Ranged or area attacks also raise an Outcrop with [icon Health] Health 3 on an empty floor target.
coverage.actual: Earth Ranged and targeted area attacks get a 3-Health Outcrop rider on empty floor. Targetless self-centered areas do not select an empty floor target.

coverage.name: Procession Lantern
coverage.treasure_text: Your [icon Illusion] Illusions can move by spending your Movement.
coverage.actual: An owned illusion can use the hero's remaining Movement through its normal navigation and spends the path's cost.

coverage.name: Crowncoal Heart
coverage.treasure_text: Once per turn, your single-target hit on a tile without [icon Fire] Fire, [icon Ice] Ice or [icon Electrified] Electrified places Fire. Bursting 2+ Fire gives 6 [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin, once per turn.
coverage.actual: Once each turn a native enemy hit on eligible bare ground paints Fire. Terrain hits do not qualify. A separate turn charge rewards 2+ actual Fire tile removals in one Burst.

coverage.name: Worldheart
coverage.treasure_text: At turn end, convert up to 2 [icon Block] Block into [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin. Deal half the Stoneskin gained to each adjacent enemy, rounded down, up to 4.
coverage.actual: Converts up to 2 Block at turn end. The damage pulse also runs on other positive Stoneskin gains and deals half the gain rounded down, capped at 4.

coverage.name: Unbound Pinion
coverage.treasure_text: Once per turn, when your Push or Pull moves an enemy 2+ tiles or causes a Collision, refill Movement and Draw 1.
coverage.actual: A qualifying enemy displacement of 2+ or a player-card collision claims a turn charge and refills Movement and draws 1.

coverage.name: Winter's Hourglass
coverage.treasure_text: Your first Ice card each turn refills 3 stored [icon Time] Time for the rest of combat. Other cards spend that Time and cost at least 1.
coverage.actual: The first normally played Ice card per turn refills a persistent reserve capped at three. Other card prices spend it down to a minimum of one.

coverage.name: Stormroad Coil
coverage.treasure_text: Your single-target Ranged attacks can relay once through an [icon Electrified] Electrified tile, with normal Range on each leg.
coverage.actual: If direct delivery fails, one visible Electrified relay is considered with normal range on both legs.

coverage.name: Eclipse Mantle
coverage.treasure_text: [diagram diamond:2] Your first Blink each turn leaves an [icon Illusion] Illusion with [icon Health] Health 2 on the tile you left. Your Illusions create [icon Light] Light 2.
coverage.actual: The first successful Blink creates a 2-Health origin decoy if it can. Decoys emit radius-2 tethered Light while alive.

coverage.name: Recoil Plates
coverage.treasure_text: You take 1 Collision damage per lost tile instead of 2. Whenever you are part of a Collision, gain 3 [icon Block] Block.
coverage.actual: The hero's base Collision damage is 1 per lost tile as either party. Each qualifying contact grants 3 Block after collision damage.

coverage.name: Millstone Fob
coverage.treasure_text: When an enemy you Push or Pull collides, that enemy's tile becomes [icon Rubble] Rubble.
coverage.actual: A hero-caused enemy mover collision lays Rubble at the stopping footprint after other collision effects.

coverage.name: Tallow Candle
coverage.treasure_text: [diagram diamond:2:hero] At the start of combat, create [icon Light] Light 2 on your tile.
coverage.actual: Creates a combat-lasting Light 2 source centered on the start tile.

coverage.name: Pocket Sundial
coverage.treasure_text: If your turn ends with no Wait, your next turn comes 2 [icon Time] Time sooner.
coverage.actual: When no normal Wait payment would be charged, the next queued turn is two Time earlier.

coverage.name: Leaden Pommel
coverage.treasure_text: Attacks on cards that cost 5 or more [icon Time] Time gain +1 Stagger.
coverage.actual: Adds one Stagger using the card's authored Time threshold, before final price adjustments.

coverage.name: Pitch Gloves
coverage.treasure_text: [icon Fire] Fire deals you 1 less damage. Fire you create deals enemies 1 more.
coverage.actual: Contact Fire applies the global -1 for the hero and +1 to enemies when the Fire source is player-owned.

coverage.name: Hobnail Cleats
coverage.treasure_text: [icon Ice] Ice doesn't [icon Expose] Expose you. While you stand on Ice, your Ice cards deal +2 damage.
coverage.actual: Ignores Ice contact Expose. The damage bonus checks the action type, which excludes White Silence.

coverage.name: Grounding Pin
coverage.treasure_text: Your single-target attacks against enemies on [icon Electrified] Electrified gain +1 Chain.
coverage.actual: Native positive-damage single-target hits against an enemy on Electrified receive +1 Chain in the route.

coverage.name: Rubblewalker Greaves
coverage.treasure_text: [icon Rubble] Rubble doesn't slow you. At the start of your turn, if you stand on Rubble, gain 1 [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin.
coverage.actual: Clears Rubble's extra departure cost for the hero and awards Stoneskin 1 on Rubble at turn start.

coverage.name: Grave Dirt
coverage.treasure_text: At the start of combat, gain 4 [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin.
coverage.actual: Adds four Stoneskin to the initial player snapshot.

coverage.name: Waxen Effigy
coverage.treasure_text: At the start of combat, create an [icon Illusion] Illusion with [icon Health] Health 2 on the empty tile adjacent to you nearest an enemy.
coverage.actual: At opening picks the adjacent empty tile nearest a visible enemy, with a center-seeking fallback when none is visible.

coverage.name: Quick-Draw Bandolier
coverage.treasure_text: Your Items don't use a [icon Card Play] Card Play, but cost 1 more [icon Time] Time.
coverage.actual: Items cost zero Card Plays and pay +1 Time after base discounts.

coverage.name: Briar Vambrace
coverage.treasure_text: When a card gives you [icon Block] Block, also gain Retaliate 1, once per card.
coverage.actual: Pays Retaliate 1 once via the direct Block and selected reward hooks. Per-tile Block from Move bypasses those hooks.

coverage.name: Fencer's Gloves
coverage.treasure_text: Your second card each turn costs 1 less [icon Time] Time.
coverage.actual: The second completed card's preview discounts its base Time by one down to the normal minimum.

coverage.name: Feint Ribbon
coverage.treasure_text: If you've traveled 2 or more tiles this turn, your first card counts as a Follow-up.
coverage.actual: Two tiles traveled allow the first card to qualify for an authored Follow-up bonus.

coverage.name: Battering Yoke
coverage.treasure_text: When your Push or Pull moves an enemy into a blocking enemy, move the blocking enemy 1 tile in the same direction, with Collision.
coverage.actual: A hero-forced collision can move a surviving blocking enemy one more tile along the same direction and resolve normal collision.

coverage.name: Pendulum Weight
coverage.treasure_text: Each point of Stagger past an enemy's per-turn limit deals 1 damage to that enemy instead.
coverage.actual: Damage equals the Stagger overflow above the cap after the target's standard Stagger resistance.

coverage.name: Martyr's Gorget
coverage.treasure_text: When your Retaliate damages an attacker, gain [icon Block] Block equal to the damage dealt.
coverage.actual: Block equals net Health removed by Retaliate's immediate damage step.

coverage.name: Reliquary Box
coverage.treasure_text: Your opening hand includes a Rite from your deck, if you have one. Each Rite costs 1 less [icon Time] Time.
coverage.actual: Swaps a Rite into the opening deal if drawn outside it. Rites receive the one-Time discount.

coverage.name: Changeling's Rattle
coverage.treasure_text: When an enemy destroys your [icon Illusion] Illusion, that enemy suffers Stagger 3 and [icon Expose] Expose 2.
coverage.actual: An enemy credited with destroying an owned illusion gains requested Stagger 3 and Expose 2, subject to status rules.

coverage.name: Copper-Shod Staff
coverage.treasure_text: For your Lightning cards, your Outcrops and [icon Illusion] Illusions count as [icon Electrified] Electrified and take no damage from those cards.
coverage.actual: Normal Lightning attack routing virtualizes owned constructs and protects owned terrain. Discharge only reads real Electrified and still damages constructs in its Burst.

coverage.name: Ashen Phylactery
coverage.treasure_text: When you Exhaust a non-Item card, gain [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin equal to the Time you paid for that card, up to 5.
coverage.actual: A non-Item card sent to the Exhaust pile awards Stoneskin equal to charged Time capped at five.

coverage.name: Bonded Set
coverage.treasure_text: Cards from an equipment piece that shares an element with another equipped piece deal 1 more damage and give 1 more [icon Block] Block.
coverage.actual: A card granted by equipped elemental gear gains +1 damage and Block when another equipped piece matches.

coverage.name: Overclock Coil
coverage.treasure_text: When you Empower a card, Quicken 2.
coverage.actual: A successfully Empowered card grants Quicken 2 at payment.

coverage.name: Fetter Spikes
coverage.treasure_text: Enemies with [icon Immobilize] Immobilize take double Collision damage.
coverage.actual: Doubles the base Collision damage against an Immobilized enemy, before independent Expose or other damage riders.

coverage.name: Mason's Plumb
coverage.treasure_text: Your Outcrops have 2 more [icon Health] Health. An enemy that collides with one of your Outcrops takes 2 more damage, and the Outcrop takes none.
coverage.actual: Player-built outcrop kinds gain two Health. As protected blockers of an enemy collision, they take zero and add two damage to the enemy.

coverage.name: The Breaking Wheel
coverage.treasure_text: When an enemy collides, remove the ground. [icon Fire] Fire: +3 damage. [icon Ice] Ice: Stagger 6. [icon Electrified] Electrified: [icon Shock] Shock the target and each enemy blocker. [icon Rubble] Rubble: Stagger 3.
coverage.actual: The moving enemy's impact ground modifies the hit and applies listed riders. Then the elemental layer and Rubble are removed.

coverage.name: Hollow Puppet
coverage.treasure_text: Your Push and Pull can move your [icon Illusion] Illusions safely. On enemy Collision, destroy that Illusion and deal its remaining [icon Health] Health to that enemy.
coverage.actual: Legal aimed force avoids the attack's normal hit on the illusion. An enemy blocking the moved illusion triggers the Health shatter. A wall leaves normal collision damage in effect.

coverage.name: Toll of the Late Bell
coverage.treasure_text: Your attacks deal +3 damage to each enemy set to act after your next turn on the Turn Clock.
coverage.actual: Adds 3 when the enemy is strictly after the projected normal player turn. The late test ignores Borrowed Hourglass's immediate next turn.

coverage.name: Rosary of Vows
coverage.treasure_text: At the start of your turn, gain 2 [icon Block] Block for each active Rite you have.
coverage.actual: Grants two Block per active Rite at player turn reset.

coverage.name: Siege Ram Totem
coverage.treasure_text: When an enemy takes Collision damage, also Stagger that enemy by the same number.
coverage.actual: Requests Stagger equal to the calculated collision damage for the mover and any enemy blockers.

coverage.name: Echoing Blade
coverage.treasure_text: When a Follow-up bonus applies, Quicken 1. Your next card this turn deals 2 more damage.
coverage.actual: After Follow-up, gives Quicken 1 and queues +2 for attack actions on the next card of the same turn.

coverage.name: Alchemist's Retort
coverage.treasure_text: Your Items' damage, [icon Block] Block, Heal and [icon Stoneskin] Stoneskin are increased by half, rounded up.
coverage.actual: Scales the named Item attack and resource values by 3/2 and rounds up.

coverage.name: Crown of Surplus
coverage.treasure_text: Cards without Empower gain Empower. Empower for +3 [icon Time] Time: repeat this card's first action. This excludes Rites and Items.
coverage.actual: Adds a three-Time Empower that repeats the first action where legal. Authored Empower, Rites, Items and legacy Flurry are excluded.

coverage.name: Mirror Triptych
coverage.treasure_text: Up to 3 [icon Illusion] Illusions repeat your first attack each turn for half damage, rounded down. Each hits the nearest reachable enemy and loses 1 [icon Health] Health.
coverage.actual: Chooses up to three live decoys that can reach a target, replays the first qualifying attack at half damage rounded down, and takes one Health per used decoy.

coverage.name: Liturgy of Ash
coverage.treasure_text: Rite cards don't use a [icon Card Play] Card Play.
coverage.actual: Rites still resolve and pay Time, but cost zero Card Plays.

coverage.name: Pyre-Keeper's Urn
coverage.treasure_text: At the start of your turn, return your last Exhausted card to your hand, unless that card is a Rite or heals.
coverage.actual: Looks at the last unreturned non-Item Exhaust record. If eligible, it moves to the hand, or the draw pile at the hand cap.

coverage.name: Briar Throne
coverage.treasure_text: Your Retaliate no longer expires and grows by 1 whenever your Retaliate deals damage. Cards can't give you [icon Block] Block.
coverage.actual: Preserves and grows Retaliate. Card and active Rite Block grants are suppressed by the defense transforms.

coverage.name: Whirling Sash
coverage.treasure_text: Gain 1 extra [icon Card Play] Card Play each turn. Each card after your second each turn costs 2 more [icon Time] Time.
coverage.actual: Raises the Card Play capacity by one. Cards after two completed cards pay the two-Time surcharge.

coverage.name: Quartermaster's Ledger
coverage.treasure_text: Your Items Exhaust instead of Consume, except items that heal. Use each eligible item once per combat.
coverage.actual: Non-healing Items exhaust the physical card for combat instead of using it up permanently.
